title: Cytotoxicity of dioncophylline A and related naphthylisoquinolines in leukemia cells, mediated by NF-kappaB inhibition, angiogenesis suppression, G2/M cell cycle arrest, and autophagy induction.
authors: Yucer, Rumeysa; Fayez, Shaimaa; Feineis, Doris; Klauck, Sabine M; Shan, Letian; Bringmann, Gerhard; Efferth, Thomas; Dawood, Mona
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物dioncophylline A对白血病细胞的细胞毒性及NF-kappaB抑制机制，虽含分子对接预测小分子与NF-kappaB结合，但核心是药物细胞毒性与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inhibition of NF-kappaB activity represents a strategy to treat acute myeloid leukemia, one of the most lethal leukemia types. Naphthylisoquinolines (NIQs) are cytotoxic alkaloids from lianas of the families Ancistrocladaceae and Dioncophyllaceae, which are indigenous to tropical rainforests. PURPOSE: Uncovering therapeutic possibilities and underlying molecular mechanisms of dioncophylline A and its derivatives towards NF-kappaB related cellular processes. METHODS: Resazurin-based cell viability assay was performed for dioncophylline A and three derivatives on wild-type CCRF-CEM and multidrug-resistant CEM/ADR5000 cells. Transcriptome analysis was executed to discover cellular functions and molecular networks associated with dioncophylline A treatment. Expression changes obtained by mRNA microarray hybridization were confirmed using qRT-PCR. Molecular docking was applied to predict the affinity of the NIQs with NF-kappaB. To validate the in silico approach, NF-kappaB reporter assays were conducted on HEK-Blue Null1 cells. Cell death mechanisms and cell cycle arrest were studied using flow cytometry. The potential activity on angiogenesis was evaluated with the endothelial cell tube formation assay on HUVECs using fluorescence microscopy. Intracellular NF-kappaB location in HEK-Blue Null1 cells was visualized with immunofluorescence. Finally, the anti-tumor activity of dioncophylline A was studied by a xenograft zebrafish model in vivo. RESULTS: Our study demonstrated that dioncophylline A and its derivatives exerted potent cytotoxicity on leukemia cells. Using Ingenuity Pathway Analysis, we identified the NF-kappaB network as the top network, and docking experiments predicted dioncophylline A and two of its derivatives sharing the same binding pocket with the positive control compound, triptolide. Dioncophylline A showed the best inhibitory activity in NF-kappaB reporter assays compared to its derivatives, caused autophagy rather than apoptosis, and induced G2/M arrest. It also prevented NF-kappaB translocation from the cytoplasm to the nucleus. Tube formation as an angiogenesis marker was significantly suppressed by dioncophylline A treatment. Finally, the remarkable anti-tumor activity of dioncophylline A was proven in zebrafish in vivo. CONCLUSION: Taken together, we report for the first time the molecular mechanism behind the cytotoxic effect of dioncophylline A on leukemia cells. Dioncophylline A showed strong cytotoxic activity, inhibited NF-kappaB translocation, significantly affected the NF-kappaB in silico and in vitro, subdued tube formation, induced autophagy, and exerted antitumor activity in vivo. Our findings enlighten both the cellular functions including the NF-kappaB signaling pathway and the cytotoxic mechanism affected by dioncophylline A.
abstract_zh: 背景：抑制NF-kappaB活性代表了一种治疗急性髓系白血病（一种最致命的白血病类型）的策略。萘基异喹啉类生物碱（NIQs）是来自热带雨林原生的Ancistrocladaceae和Dioncophyllaceae科藤本植物中的细胞毒性生物碱。目的：揭示dioncophylline A及其衍生物对NF-kappaB相关细胞过程的治疗可能性及潜在分子机制。方法：对dioncophylline A及其三种衍生物在野生型CCRF-CEM和多药耐药CEM/ADR5000细胞上进行基于刃天青的细胞活力测定。进行转录组分析以发现与dioncophylline A处理相关的细胞功能和分子网络。通过mRNA微阵列杂交获得的表达变化使用qRT-PCR进行验证。应用分子对接预测NIQs与NF-kappaB的亲和力。为验证该计算机模拟方法，在HEK-Blue Null1细胞上进行NF-kappaB报告基因测定。使用流式细胞术研究细胞死亡机制和细胞周期阻滞。通过HUVECs上的内皮细胞管形成实验，使用荧光显微镜评估对血管生成的潜在活性。通过免疫荧光可视化HEK-Blue Null1细胞内的NF-kappaB定位。最后，通过异种移植斑马鱼模型在体内研究dioncophylline A的抗肿瘤活性。结果：我们的研究表明，dioncophylline A及其衍生物对白血病细胞表现出强效细胞毒性。使用Ingenuity Pathway Analysis，我们确定NF-kappaB网络为顶级网络，对接实验预测dioncophylline A及其两种衍生物与阳性对照化合物雷公藤甲素共享同一结合口袋。在NF-kappaB报告基因测定中，dioncophylline A与其衍生物相比显示出最佳抑制活性，引起自噬而非凋亡，并诱导G2/M期阻滞。它还阻止了NF-kappaB从细胞质向细胞核的转位。作为血管生成标志物的管形成被dioncophylline A处理显著抑制。最后，dioncophylline A的显著抗肿瘤活性在斑马鱼体内得到证实。结论：综上所述，我们首次报道了dioncophylline A对白血病细胞细胞毒性效应背后的分子机制。Dioncophylline A表现出强细胞毒性活性，抑制NF-kappaB转位，在计算机模拟和体外显著影响NF-kappaB，抑制管形成，诱导自噬，并在体内发挥抗肿瘤活性。我们的发现阐明了包括NF-kappaB信号通路在内的细胞功能以及受dioncophylline A影响的细胞毒性机制。
